t: Enterprise plans can manage connector access with custom roles
s: We added connector permissions to extend the existing custom roles framework and allow administrators to control which connectors, and which individual tools on those connectors, are available to each custom role.
We’ve upgraded Claude Opus to a new version. Claude Opus 4.8 shows improvements over Opus 4.7 in coding, agentic skills, reasoning, and practical knowledge work tasks.

t: How we contain Claude across products
s: As agents grow more capable, so does their potential blast radius. The engineering question is how to cap it. Here’s what we’ve learned building containment for claude.ai, Claude Code, and Cowork.

t: Claude now works with more security and compliance tools
